hero.sub: For people who need privacy, continuity, and control of their data. No cloud dependency. No lock-in. No compromise.

wtb.p1: Hyperion Industries builds local-first tools and custom systems for people who need privacy, continuity, and control.
wtb.p2: We are not a generic SaaS company. We build software and hardware that can run close to the work: on your machine, around your files, under your control.

forgePreview.desc: Custom PCs, sim rigs, local AI boxes, and deployment-ready workstations. Hand-built machines tuned around your workload, room, budget, and taste.

doctrine.p1: Hyperion is built around a simple belief: useful intelligence should stay close to the people who own the work.
doctrine.p2: That means local-first tools, clear provenance, protected source while systems mature, and AI that helps without quietly taking control.
doctrine.quote: "Uploaded content informs the system. Uploaded content never commands the system."
doctrine.cite: Hyperion Doctrine · Section II — Agency Governance

hero.title: Physical systems for local-first work.
hero.lead: Custom PCs, sim rigs, local AI boxes, and deployment-ready workstations. The Forge is where Hyperion systems become physical: quiet, powerful, serviceable machines built around the work they need to carry.

future.title: Scaffolded, not rushed.
future.lead: The configurator is intentionally not live yet. For now, build inquiries stay human so the system matches the budget, workload, taste, and room it will live in.
future.planned: Planned: build quiz, intake form, budget/use-case selector, benchmark vault, showcase videos, and repair/mod service lanes.

hero.title: Bring the right signal.
hero.lead: Reach out for CHR0N.OS pilots, custom builds, deployments, partnerships, support, and aligned collaborations. Hyperion is currently prioritizing builds, pilots, and strategic partnerships.

instructions.title: What to include.
instructions.desc: For build inquiries, send your budget range, primary use case, timeline, aesthetic direction, and any must-have hardware. For systems or pilot conversations, send the problem, data type, operating constraints, and what success looks like.

store.title: Store
store.desc: Future merch, prints, build deposits, and hardware/service products. This lane is being designed with the same care as the machines — not bolted on early.
